market_definition: Meter-Mix-Dispense Systems comprises integrated equipment that meters, mixes and dispenses multi-component adhesives, sealants, potting compounds or other reactive materials at specified ratios. The scope includes complete systems and their material delivery and mixing units. By System Type • Meter-Mix-Dispense • Meter-Mix Only • Multi-Component Dosing By Metering Technology • Gear Pump • Piston Pump • Progressive Cavity • Servo-Controlled Metering By Component Count • Two-Component • Three-Component • Multi-Component By Dispensing Mode • Manual Trigger • Automated Bead / Shot • Robotic Cell • Continuous Dispensing By End Use • Automotive • Electronics • Aerospace • Construction • Industrial Manufacturing By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Single-component dispensers, standalone mixers, adhesive and sealant chemicals, and general-purpose dosing equipment not designed for reactive materials. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - EQUIPMENT DISTRIBUTOR / DEALER: a distributor, authorised dealer, agent or system integrator that sells this equipment made by others to manufacturers. EXCLUDED companies: equipment makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR / CHANNEL PARTNER DEFINITION (hardware + software market): this market sells both hardware and software, so two shapes qualify - a stocking or authorized DISTRIBUTOR buying hardware in volume and reselling it, and a CHANNEL PARTNER, value-added reseller or SYSTEM INTEGRATOR that resells, bundles or implements another vendor's platform, software or modules. EXCLUDED: manufacturers, OEMs and their sales subsidiaries; vendors selling their own platform; consultancies with nothing to resell; and consumer-only retailers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
